stories.title: 双节临近 海鲜、水果购销两旺

en.title: As dual festivals approach, seafood and fruit sales surge
en.summary: With the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays coinciding, consumer spending for holiday purchases has intensified. Specialty fruit and aquatic product wholesale markets across various regions are experiencing peak purchasing activity.

en.title: From encounter to understanding: US-China cultural exchange through the eyes of leading figures
en.summary: The headline discusses perspectives from prominent cultural figures in the United States and China on bilateral cultural exchanges and international relations between the two nations.

stories.title: 打开专业“盲盒”：87.5%受访大一学生感觉与设想有出入

en.title: Opening the professional 'mystery box': 87.5% of surveyed first-year students find their major differs from expectations
en.summary: A majority of first-year university students report that their actual experience with their chosen major differs from what they anticipated when applying. The transition from selecting a major on paper to experiencing it through coursework has revealed discrepancies in their understanding.

stories.title: US restricts visas for birth tourism ahead of Xi Jinping’s summit with Trump

en.title: US restricts visas for birth tourism ahead of Xi Jinping's summit with Trump
en.summary: Hours before Chinese President Xi Jinping's arrival in the United States for talks with President Trump, the US State Department announced restrictions on visa issuance for individuals engaged in or profiting from birth tourism, citing concerns about exploitation of the immigration system.

stories.title: Xi lands in US for high-stakes summit with Trump amid deep tensions

en.title: Xi lands in US for high-stakes summit with Trump amid deep tensions
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived at Joint Base Andrews after a 15-hour flight, where he was met by US President Trump in an unprecedented greeting. The summit, Xi's first in the United States in 11 years, addresses contentious issues including artificial intelligence, critical minerals, tariffs, and Ukraine.

en.title: Xi Jinping arrives in Washington for state visit to the United States
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington on September 23rd afternoon to begin a state visit to the United States, according to Xinhua News Agency.

en.title: China is leveraging its diaspora to boost the economy, unlike India
en.summary: China and India employ different strategies regarding their large diaspora populations. China actively leverages its diaspora to strengthen the economy through remittances, investments, and expertise transfer, while India has adopted a contrasting approach.

en.summary: New rules governing long-term care insurance payment have been implemented in China, with experts providing interpretation of the regulations.

en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping is meeting US President Donald Trump in Washington for their first face-to-face talks since Trump's May visit to Beijing.

stories.title: Ukraine’s Zelensky warns of painful winter for Russia if energy truce talks fail

en.title: Ukraine's Zelensky warns of painful winter for Russia if energy truce talks fail
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky warned Russia that Ukraine will retaliate and inflict severe winter hardships if no agreement is reached on halting energy infrastructure attacks before the cold season.

en.title: Trump offloads tens of millions in AI, tech shares, led by Microsoft, Amazon, Meta
en.summary: US President Trump sold tens of millions of dollars in shares of major technology companies including Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta in July. Microsoft represented the largest portion of sales with six transactions totaling approximately 31 million dollars.

en.title: Bad money decisions are coming home to roost for the US and Japan
en.summary: The US Treasury market faces challenges as 10-year Treasury yields reached their highest level since 2007, while oil prices surge and the yen faces potential depreciation. The US government's ability to stabilize global markets through Treasury operations faces limitations.

en.title: Hong Kong sets yuan trading timeline, backing Beijing's push to boost currency's use
en.summary: Hong Kong's financial regulator announced plans to establish a yuan trading counter within a cross-border investment channel by July 1. The initiative supports efforts to expand the international use of China's currency.

en.title: Hong Kong unveils gold, bond and liquidity plans to drive next phase of yuan adoption
en.summary: Hong Kong's exchange operator plans to launch yuan-denominated gold futures in early 2025, while the city's central bank will introduce additional yuan products and platforms to support the currency's internationalization and digital development.

en.title: Physical moves by online financial firms unlikely to pump up property market: analysts
en.summary: Digital financial firms in Hong Kong are opening physical locations to strengthen brand presence and compete for market share, though analysts expect limited impact on the city's retail property market.
